item.title: [New] Sensitivity labels for Entra cloud security groups reach GA from mid-November; a label once applied cannot be changed or removed yet
item.description:
Security groups gate access to apps and resources; a label that sets guest access and cannot be removed is a one-way change on objects that Conditional Access and app assignments depend on.

Purview · Before labelling any security group, test on a throw-away group, decide which groups may carry a label, and restrict who can apply labels to groups.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Exchange Online DLP gains a 'Count of labeled documents is greater than' condition (preview November, GA December)
item.description:
Bulk sending of labeled files is a classic exfiltration pattern; a volume condition gives a DLP signal that content matching alone misses.

Purview · Plan a test rule in simulation mode with a threshold based on normal business volume once the preview reaches the tenant.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Teams meeting options will offer only the automatic recording and transcription choices the organizer's policy allows, and add 'Record only'
item.description:
Recording without a transcript becomes a one-click default, which changes what a compliance or eDiscovery search finds for a meeting.

Teams · Check which meeting policies allow recording but block transcription; tell organizers about 'Record only' if transcripts are relied on for retention.

item.title: [New] The October 2026 Scan Cab (wsusscn2.cab) is now available, a day late
item.description:
Offline compliance scans run since Patch Tuesday used the September cab and under-reported missing October updates; they can now be re-run.

Windows · Download the new wsusscn2.cab and re-run any offline compliance scan taken between 13 and 14 October.

item.title: [New] Purview DLP policies for Copilot, Copilot Chat and Cowork can be scoped to administrative units (roadmap, November 2026)
item.description:
Delegated DLP administration for AI surfaces means a regional admin can weaken Copilot protection for their unit without tenant-wide rights.

Purview · If you adopt AU-scoped DLP, audit Purview role assignments scoped to administrative units and alert on Copilot DLP policy edits.

item.title: [New] Purview server-side auto-labeling will cover legacy .doc, .xls and .ppt files in SharePoint and OneDrive (roadmap, November 2026)
item.description:
Legacy binary Office files were a blind spot for auto-labeling, so sensitive content in old archives stayed unlabeled and invisible to label-based DLP.

Purview · When it ships, expect a jump in auto-labeling activity in the audit log and re-baseline label-change alerts.

item.title: [New] Search-UnifiedAuditLog retires on 15 October 2027; the Graph AuditLogQuery API is generally available now and replaces it
item.description:
Every SOC script, SOAR playbook and SIEM pull that calls Search-UnifiedAuditLog stops returning audit data on 15 October 2027. The replacement is asynchronous, throttled at 200 searches a day per tenant, and grants audit reach per workload through new Graph application permissions, so an app holding AuditLogsQuery.Read.All can read the audit log of every service.

Purview · Inventory every script, runbook and connector that calls Search-UnifiedAuditLog; plan the move to POST /security/auditLog/queries with the narrowest AuditLogsQuery-<workload>.Read.All permission; size investigations against the 200-per-day limit; and add the AuditLogsQuery permissions to the app-consent review list.

item.title: [New] Archiving SharePoint files under retention policies slips to early December 2026 (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
item.description:
Archived files leave Copilot's index but stay in eDiscovery, which changes what an investigator can find through Copilot against what holds and searches return.

Purview · No action before December; when it lands, record which retention policies archive and tell eDiscovery users that archived files are found by search, not by Copilot.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Purview network DLP through Global Secure Access can be scoped to all websites, or all websites except named cloud apps
item.description:
Network DLP has covered only catalogued cloud apps; an all-websites scope closes the path of pasting or uploading data to an unlisted site, and changes the volume of DLP events the SOC receives from GSA traffic.

Purview · If GSA Internet Access and Purview network DLP are deployed, plan a report-only all-websites policy when it lands and estimate the alert volume before enforcing.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Default SharePoint library sensitivity labels will be applied to existing files at rest (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
item.description:
Files that predate a library's default label stay unlabelled today, so DLP and label-based access controls miss them; the feature labels them in bulk, which also produces a burst of label-change audit events.

Purview · In government clouds, list libraries with a default label and expect label-applied events for their existing files when the feature lands; no date beyond November CY2026 is stated.

item.title: [New] Purview DLP can stop Copilot from using external web search for a prompt that contains sensitive information types
item.description:
Until now the web-search control for Copilot was on or off. A content-aware control means web grounding can stay enabled for ordinary work while a prompt carrying a card number or a passport number stays inside the tenant boundary.

Purview · Add the Copilot location to the DLP policy that already defines your sensitive information types, in audit mode first, and review matches for a week.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] A Purview DLP policy can now keep Microsoft 365 Copilot from grounding answers in mail received from external senders
item.description:
Indirect prompt injection through an inbound message is the attack on Copilot that needs no access to the tenant at all. This is a tenant-side control for it that does not depend on detecting the injected text.

Purview · Pilot the policy on a group that receives a lot of external mail and measure what Copilot stops being able to answer before widening it.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Audit log query API: Microsoft now states that keywordFilter matches only the non-indexed auditData content, not the operation name or other indexed properties
item.description:
An audit search built through Graph that puts an operation name into keywordFilter returns nothing for it, and the empty result looks like 'no such activity'. Microsoft's text now says which filter each kind of value belongs in.

Graph · Review scripts and playbooks that create audit log queries through Graph: move operation names to operationFilters, record types to recordTypeFilters and users to userPrincipalNameFilters, and keep keywordFilter for values found inside auditData.

item.title: [New] Sensitivity labels for Entra cloud security groups slip from August to November 2026 (roadmap)
item.description:
Labels configured for groups and sites become applicable to security groups without a second configuration step, so whoever can label a group gains a say over security groups that gate access. The slip gives three more months to decide who that should be.

Purview · No action stated by Microsoft. Before November, review which sensitivity labels are scoped to groups and sites and who may apply them.
